predecessors.name: Kongemose Culture
predecessors.text: Denmark and Skane, where the Ertebølle 'replaced the earlier Kongemose culture of Denmark' (Kongemose: 'known from Denmark and Skåne')

successors.name: Funnelbeaker culture
successors.text: the Ertebølle country, where the Funnelbeaker 'replaced the Ertebølle culture' in southern Scandinavia and whose northern group is 'roughly the area that previously belonged to the Ertebølle-Ellerbek…

ledger.x: 5400 BCE: the Ertebølle culture appears in southern Scandinavia.
4100 BCE: the Ertebølle spreads along the Baltic coast to Rügen.
3950 BCE: the Funnelbeaker culture replaces the Ertebølle.

certainty.note: A hunter-gatherer culture known from coastal middens; the page gives no frontier, and the extent is the researcher's reading of country and region names.
